name: @ufoq/opencode-agent-terminal
description: OpenCode plugin that bundles the agent-terminal CLI and skill
author: ufoq

scripts.build: rm -rf dist skills bin && cp -R ../../skills skills && export PATH="/home/agent/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && export CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_MUSL_LINKER=/home/agent/.cache/agent-terminal-musl-audit-e769f7b/toolchains/aarch64-linux-musl-cross/bin/aarch64-linux-musl-gcc && cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && mkdir -p bin/linux-x64 bin/linux-arm64 && cp ../../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/agent-terminal bin/linux-x64/agent-terminal && cp ../../../target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/agent-terminal bin/linux-arm64/agent-terminal && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
